old_description: Montana Auto & Fabrication is a complete custom fabrication shop. The company began operations in 2008 and has established itself as a custom off road vehicle shop. Our goal is to take an idea and make it a reality. We are always looking for new projects. Follow us on social media to see our latest work!
about:
Montana Auto & Fabrication operates from Helena, Montana, where it was founded in 2008 by Ryan Weber. Weber purchased Rocky Mountain Radiator that same year and launched the fabrication business alongside it, aiming to turn custom concepts into finished metalwork.

The shop handles a wide range of fabrication tasks, from complete off‑road vehicle builds to partial modifications such as axle swaps, gear setups, lift kits, and custom bumpers and fenders. Beyond automotive work, the team produces custom signage, brewery piping, railings, and sandblasted components for residential and commercial clients. A small crew of fabricators and technicians works with aluminum, stainless steel, and mild steel to deliver one‑off parts and small‑batch projects.

Customers include off‑road enthusiasts building rigs like the Toyota FJ80 and FJ40, breweries needing stainless staircases, canning‑line platforms, and mill‑room adapters, as well as businesses and homeowners requiring custom metalwork. The company also stocks and installs parts from a long list of off‑road brands such as Rough Country, ARB, and Warn.

Weber says the business was started to “take an idea and make it a reality,” emphasizing a willingness to tackle projects of any size. Testimonials highlight on‑time delivery, fair pricing, and a focus on quality craftsmanship across materials and applications.
